model.title: Model
model.description: LLM model for the agent (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6). Leave empty for agent's default.

scenario.title: Testing Scenario
scenario.description: Markdown with YAML frontmatter + ## Test / ## Checkpoint sections separated by ---. Checkpoint supports: contains:, regex:, json-schema:, script: prefixes for deterministic checks, and plain text for LLM judge. Multiple checks in one checkpoint all must pass.
scenario.prefill:
---
name: example-eval
description: Simple eval demonstrating checkpoint types
abortOnFailure: false
---

## Test
What is the largest planet in our solar system? Answer in one sentence.

## Checkpoint
contains: Jupiter
The answer should be scientifically accurate.

systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.description: Instructions for the agent at the start of each test. Default: 'You are an AI agent being evaluated. Always respond in English. Follow the instructions precisely.'

maxBudgetUsd.title: Max Budget (USD)
maxBudgetUsd.description: Spending cap for the entire run. Soft limit — checked between agent turns, actual cost may slightly exceed this value.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries on Failure
maxRetries.description: Retry a failed test this many times before marking as failed. Useful for non-deterministic tasks.

maxTurns.title: Max Turns per Test
maxTurns.description: Maximum agent turns (tool calls) per test. Use 3 for simple questions, 10+ for multi-step tasks.

envVariables.title: Environment Variables
envVariables.description: API keys and secrets as JSON object (e.g. {"GITHUB_TOKEN": "ghp_...", "APIFY_TOKEN": "apify_api_..."}). Available to agent and init script. Automatically masked in logs.

initPreset.title: Tool Setup Preset
initPreset.description: Configures what tools the agent has access to. Use different presets to compare MCP vs CLI performance on the same scenario.
enumTitles: None — agent uses only built-in capabilities
MCP Native — agent gets MCP servers from config JSON
CLI Native — agent uses command-line tools (gh, apify-cli)
mcpc — MCP servers via mcpc CLI bridge

initBashScript.title: Custom Init Script
initBashScript.description: Bash script to set up the environment before the agent runs. Use to install tools, download validators, or create test fixtures. Runs after the preset. Timeout: 5 minutes.

judgeMode.title: Judge Mode
judgeMode.description: How to run the LLM judge. 'auto' uses Anthropic SDK if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is in env variables (faster, with cost tracking), falls back to claude CLI otherwise. 'cli' forces claude -p (works with OAuth). 'sdk' forces Anthropic SDK (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
enumTitles: Auto — SDK if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY provided, CLI otherwise
CLI — uses claude -p (works with OAuth token)
SDK — uses Anthropic API directly (faster, requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

mcpConfigJson.title: MCP Config JSON
mcpConfigJson.description: MCP server configuration. Required for 'MCP Native' and 'mcpc' presets. Token placeholders like ${APIFY_TOKEN} are resolved from Environment Variables.
